feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: People along the Gulf Coast prepare for Hurricane Isaias
entry.summary: Isaias became the first hurricane of the Atlantic season late Wednesday. It's expected to make landfall along the U.S. Gulf Coast Friday.

entry.title: Former NOAA official on coastal cities' vulnerabilities during severe weather
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep talks with former NOAA official Carolyn Gruber about vulnerabilities in the infrastructure of coastal cities during extreme weather events.

entry.title: Teen arrested for alleged shooting plot at the Mall of America, authorities say
entry.summary: Federal prosecutors say a teenager is under arrest, under suspicion of plotting a mass shooting at Minnesota's Mall of America.

entry.title: Toss-ups, triage and targets: How to read the wide-open 2026 House map
entry.summary: Both parties are spending heavily in roughly 60 House districts — where Trump won by an average of 9 points in 2024 — that could be key to deciding control of the chamber, an NPR analysis finds.

entry.title: Flock is catching flak. Experts say other police surveillance tools are more worrisome
entry.summary: Real-time crime-center software is a sometimes overlooked but powerful tool allowing police to aggregate immense amounts of data, significantly expanding their surveillance reach.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Gulf Coast residents prepare for Hurricane Isaias, with midterms just weeks away, a look at the state of play for the House, media companies barred from White House return to court.

entry.title: How 'Musk' director Alex Gibney became a critic
entry.summary: A trove of documents and interviews with people close to tech billionaire Elon Musk reveal a damning picture of his rise as one of the world's richest and most powerful men.

entry.title: FBI teams that investigate foreign espionage hit by cuts, NPR finds
entry.summary: NPR has exclusive reporting that under the Trump administration, the FBI teams that work on catching foreign spies have been hit with major staffing cuts.

entry.title: As protests continue across France, the country's prime minister addresses the nation
entry.summary: France's prime minister says students' demands for better school resources will be heard, but his pledge wasn't enough to quell protesters.

entry.title: Poet and essayist Anne Carson wins 2026 Nobel Prize in literature
entry.summary: Carson's writing, including The Beauty of the Husband, Autobiography of Red, and Eros the Bittersweet, is eclectic in genre and theme.
